```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(data.table)
library(here)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  results = 'asis',
  cache = FALSE
)

db_path <- file.path(here("output"), "legislation.db")
conn <- dbConnect(SQLite(), dbname = db_path)

# Load tables
legislation_table <- as.data.table(dbReadTable(conn, "LegislationMetadata"))
paragraph_table <- as.data.table(dbReadTable(conn, "LegislationParagraphs"))
paragraph_label_table <- as.data.table(dbReadTable(conn, "paragraph_label_table"))

dbDisconnect(conn)

# Filter for Federal Acts only
legislation_table <- legislation_table[jurisdiction == "Federal" & legislation_type == "Act"]

invisible(gc())
```

```{r label-tally-by-scope, echo=FALSE}
federal_act_paragraph_ids <- merge(
  paragraph_table[, .(paragraph_id, legislation_id)],
  legislation_table[, .(legislation_id)],
  by = "legislation_id"
)$paragraph_id

scope_tally <- paragraph_label_table[
  paragraph_id %in% federal_act_paragraph_ids & label_type == "Management Domain" & !is.na(scope) & scope != "", 
  .N, 
  by = scope
]
setorder(scope_tally, scope)

cat("# Labels by Scope - Federal Acts\n\n")

if (nrow(scope_tally) > 0) {
  cat("| Scope | Count |\n")
  cat("|-------|-------|\n")
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(scope_tally))) {
    cat(sprintf("| %s | %d |\n", scope_tally[i]$scope, scope_tally[i]$N))
  }
  
  cat(sprintf("\n**Total Labels:** %d\n\n", sum(scope_tally$N)))
} else {
  cat("No scope labels found in the data.\n\n")
}

rm(scope_tally, federal_act_paragraph_ids)
invisible(gc())
```

```{r display-hierarchy-with-labels , echo=FALSE}
paragraph_with_metadata <- merge(
  paragraph_table[, .(paragraph_id, legislation_id, Paragraph, Section, Heading)],
  legislation_table[, .(legislation_id, jurisdiction, legislation_type, act_name, legislation_name)],
  by = "legislation_id",
  all.x = TRUE
)

rm(paragraph_table, legislation_table)
invisible(gc())

cat("# Federal Acts\n\n")

acts <- unique(paragraph_with_metadata$act_name)
acts <- acts[!is.na(acts)]

for (act in acts) {
  cat(sprintf("## %s\n\n", act))
  
  names <- unique(paragraph_with_metadata[act_name == act]$legislation_name)
  names <- names[!is.na(names)]
  
  for (name in names) {
    anchor_id <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9-]", "-", name)
    anchor_id <- gsub("-+", "-", anchor_id)
    anchor_id <- gsub("^-|-$", "", anchor_id)
    anchor_id <- tolower(anchor_id)
    
    cat(sprintf("### %s {#%s}\n\n", name, anchor_id))
    
    all_paragraphs <- paragraph_with_metadata[act_name == act & legislation_name == name]
    
    if (nrow(all_paragraphs) > 0) {
      all_paragraphs[, Section_numeric := suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Section))]
      setorder(all_paragraphs, Section_numeric, paragraph_id)
      
      current_heading <- ""
      batch_size <- 50
      n_paragraphs <- nrow(all_paragraphs)
      
      for (batch_start in seq(1, n_paragraphs, by = batch_size)) {
        batch_end <- min(batch_start + batch_size - 1, n_paragraphs)
        
        for (i in batch_start:batch_end) {
          prov <- all_paragraphs[i]
          
          heading_text <- ""
          if (!is.na(prov$Heading) && prov$Heading != "") {
            heading_text <- prov$Heading
          }
          if (!is.na(prov$Section) && prov$Section != "") {
            heading_text <- if (heading_text != "") {
              sprintf("%s | Section %s", heading_text, prov$Section)
            } else {
              sprintf("Section %s", prov$Section)
            }
          }
          
          if (heading_text != "" && heading_text != current_heading) {
            current_heading <- heading_text
            cat(sprintf("**%s**\n\n", heading_text))
          }
          
          paragraph_text <- prov$Paragraph
          if (nchar(paragraph_text) > 5000) {
            paragraph_text <- paste0(substr(paragraph_text, 1, 4900), "... [truncated]")
          }
          cat(sprintf("%s", paragraph_text))
          
          labels <- paragraph_label_table[
            paragraph_id == prov$paragraph_id & label_type %in% c("Management Domain", "IUCN", "Clause Type"),
            .(label_type, label_value, scope)
          ]
          
          if (nrow(labels) > 0) {
            label_parts <- list()
            for (j in seq_len(nrow(labels))) {
              row <- labels[j]
              if (row$label_type == "Management Domain" && !is.na(row$label_value)) {
                label_parts <- c(label_parts, paste("Management Domain:", row$label_value))
                if (!is.na(row$scope) && row$scope != "") {
                  label_parts <- c(label_parts, paste("Scope:", row$scope))
                }
              } else if (row$label_type == "IUCN" && !is.na(row$label_value)) {
                label_parts <- c(label_parts, paste("IUCN Threat:", row$label_value))
              } else if (row$label_type == "Clause Type" && !is.na(row$label_value)) {
                label_parts <- c(label_parts, paste("Clause Type:", row$label_value))
              }
            }
            if (length(label_parts) > 0) {
              cat(sprintf("\n\n<span style='color: blue; font-style: italic;'>%s</span>", 
                          paste(label_parts, collapse=" | ")))
            }
          }
          
          cat("\n\n")
        }
        
        if (batch_start %% (batch_size * 5) == 1) {
          invisible(gc())
        }
      }
      
      rm(all_paragraphs)
    }
  }
}

rm(paragraph_with_metadata, paragraph_label_table)
invisible(gc())
```
